Built

E-commerce support

Customers write on Instagram or WhatsApp, the assistant answers within what it may share, and a refund is an approve-only proposal.

How it runs

  1. EventA customer via Instagram or WhatsAppAsks about an order.
  2. PlanThe assistant via modelAnswers under the shop's clearance: it can only say what it is allowed to say.
  3. PlanA human agent via person insideTakes over when the assistant hands off.
  4. ProposalThe human agent no tool neededA refund is a money proposal that can only be approved by a person, never run on its own.
  5. ReceiptThe order no tool neededClosed with a receipt.

What it keeps to
